title: Accelerating Federal Permitting of Data Center Infrastructure
key_terms: a facility that requires greater than 100 megawatts (MW) of new load dedicated to AI inference
involving an incremental electric load addition of greater than 100 MW
will utilize federally owned land and resources for the expeditious and orderly development of data centers.
summary: Presidential order directing federal agencies to speed permitting of data center projects and their supporting energy infrastructure. Qualifying projects include those adding more than 100 MW of load, and the order provides for use of federally owned land for data centers.
source_title: The White House — Accelerating Federal Permitting of Data Center Infrastructure
